sentences.text:
This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.709/2023 registered at Police Station - Seonimalwa, District Hoshangabad (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 304B,
34 of IPC and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

Applicant is in detention since 09.01.2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, prior to one and half year of the incident i.e.10.07.2023, one Jyoti Bhalavi (deceased) had performed marriage with co- accused Shekhar.

It is alleged that her husband Shekhar, father-in-law, mother- in-law and brother-in-law were demanding motorcycle and used to cause cruelty with the deceased,
due to which, she committed suicide by hanging herself.
On the basis of aforesaid, Police registered the case against the present applicant under the aforesaid Sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 09.01.2024.
She has been falsely implicated.
Applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased.

It is further submitted that Nirmalabai Alias Gudiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13758625/
1 statements of independent witnesses namely Gangabai and Santosh have been recorded before the police in which they have not supported the prosecution story.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Just before the incident, neither the deceased talked with her parents nor any evidence is available against the present applicant regarding harassment or torturing the deceased.
There is no injury in the post-mortem report.
Charge sheet has been filed.
There is no criminal record of the applicant.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code o f Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that she shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

She shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE Sateesh Nirmalabai Alias Gudiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13758625/
